reason_for_fresh_extraction: User requested testing the revised general State content and diagram abstraction instructions on previously extracted methods with documented ambiguities. Original accepted records remain unchanged.

evaluation_only_not_in_model_context: Starting State explicitly identifies the supported physical preparation before crosslinking/lysis; evidence quotes or adjacent Operations alone are insufficient.
Demonstrated HeLa context remains distinguishable from broader assay scope, without unsupported universal applicability.
Preserves RNA, synthetic adapter and RNA-derived cDNA distinctions and the supported transition between them.
Existing diagram blocks remain sufficient unless a source-supported route or interface requires a new boundary.
CMC-treated and mock conditions stay distinguishable through processing and the resulting readout comparison; no invented mixing or pooling.
The RNA modification/adduct and the cDNA termination signal are correctly distinguished, with source support.
Independent conditions may use compact collections only when organization and input/output correspondence are explicit; fewer nodes alone does not count as improvement.
Each retained branch or expanded source block has a scientific reason; repeated routine procedures do not automatically improve completeness.

common_evaluation: Assess first-author output separately from any correction and final independent review.
Compare clarity and supported content, not only labels, node counts or acceptance status.
Check all new molecular, routing and readout assertions for unsupported additions or misplaced template properties.
Separate an omitted available fact, genuinely unavailable evidence and a display-only problem.
Record source-helper use, stage latency, token usage, reviewer findings and any regressions.
interpretation: Fixed-source development comparison against archived outputs. No fresh old-prompt control or repeated trials; do not attribute every difference solely to these prompt changes.
